title: Mine broke all the same way
text:
Mine broke all the same way. My joy jolt Declan coffee cups have broken the same way. They delivered safety. And after Not even 1 full month they cracked around the bottom. Very disappointed. They were all gently used for coffee and had broken while we were drinking hot coffee. Maybe too hot for coffee but that’s what I bought them for…
I’d love to have another set but not for this to happen again.
